_comment: AGENT-AUTHORED. Candidate actions the orchestrator may choose between. Exactly one is selected per cycle. Deliberately a different file from ceo/measurements/ — the agent proposes the work, it does not also report the numbers it will be judged against.

candidates.statement: Ship share_clicked / share_landed / signup_from_share and a WAU rollup, so the objective's primary metric stops being null.
candidates.rationale: Every other candidate on this list claims a lift nobody can currently observe. This one buys the ability to check them.

candidates.statement: Rewrite the /share/[barId] CTA to name the recipient's benefit rather than the sender's action.
candidates.rationale: Measured CTR on the live catalog is 1.485%; the click, not the landing, is the funnel's narrow point.

candidates.statement: Let a signed-out recipient cast one 0-10 vote on the shared bar before any auth wall.
candidates.rationale: The vote is the onboarding; a signup wall in front of it spends the one moment of intent the share bought.

candidates.statement: Walk one neighborhood and hand-claim 40 venues.
candidates.rationale: Supply side of the two-sided objective.
